goal: Prevent BIP 157 light clients from disconnecting or banning nodes during block propagation
Avoid dropped filter requests when clients request compact filters before the node finishes building them
agreement: Broad support for handling racing compact filter requests without disconnecting peers
Support because filter calculations are slow enough that races happen in practice (ajtowns)
Support because handling races prevents disconnects without delaying transaction responses (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because BIP 157 light clients drop connections or ban nodes during regular block announcements
The race condition triggers in real network traffic even for peers not using compact block relay
